name: StepFun
description: Step-series models with a signup credit and a 15-day plan trial.
overview: StepFun's open platform serves the Step family — Step-2, Step 3.5 Flash and agent-oriented models — over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.stepfun.com/v1. New accounts receive roughly ¥10 of credit (about a million tokens) at 5 RPM, and periodic promotions add 15 days of the Step Plan subscription, extendable by inviting other developers. Step Plan traffic uses a separate base URL and quota pool.
notes: Step Plan and pay-as-you-go use separate base URLs and separate quotas.
